subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: arent you going to have any said i no i never eat asparagus i know there are people who dont like them the fact is that you ruin your palate by all the meat you eat she said. Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: "Aren't you going to have any?" said I. "No, I never eat asparagus." "I know, there are people who don't like them. The fact is that you ruin your palate by all the meat you eat," she said. Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book
